metadata.title: Confidently Wrong.
metadata.note: Weekly update. Narrator Muskan, @HumanitariansAI, banner 'Vendor Intelligence'. ONE insight: every bug this week was an assumption nobody verified — that the model had the evidence, that the fix reached old data, that a no-error system was working. Rule: don't assume, verify. Bookends render (composer/verdict/handoff/outro); body B01-B04 are house-style 4K PIL cards in media/. DOUBLE-CHECK LAW: every detail from the creator's own change log (Ajay K. Puri, AMD equity-plan amendment, boilerplate title, 400→900 chars, 8 rows / 955 total, Langfuse silent trace + flush crash).

source_of_truth: beat_sheet.json — edit the sheet, not this file
